provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.
licenses: Project MIT for the component; pinned Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC) icons and ECharts 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0) via the existing vendor manifest; no new third-party files.

checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch
no ellipsis, collision, occlusion or clipping

purpose: Show how values are distributed across explicit bins, with the tail visible.
use_when: Latency, token counts, error sizes: any distribution where the average misleads.
not_when: Categorical comparisons (use visual:bar) or unbounded raw samples; supply bins, not samples.

parameters.counts: edges-1 nonnegative numbers, at least one nonzero
parameters.marker: null or {label <= 16, value within the edges}

limits: Zero bins are drawn as a line and labeled 0; counts render exactly, including fractions.
